notes: Two opposing kingdoms with team roles fighting over several territory points is a team objective map, and only Shooter can express held points and opposing bases, so it leads; Action is named second because the penguin fighting itself is close-quarters rather than ranged, which made the call close. Shape is open-battlefield because the author chose several capture points spread across a small map rather than one contested middle or parallel lanes, and it keeps the build on P0. King of the Hill is the multi-point territory mode, taken on open-battlefield instead of its lane-network shape, with spawn-teambase added for the two kingdoms; I dropped its cover-elevated because nothing asked for firing nests and it would have added tiered elevation to a map the author wants small and readable. Deciding without a user: the roles are loadouts and get no buildings, as the author confirmed, and the win condition of taking every territory point is carried by control-zone placement rather than a separate goal feature.
